tasks.Count_Orange_Items: Counting the remaining orange items on the floor after removing scrunchiephone chargers
tasks.Remove_Scrunchiephone_Chargers: Removing all scrunchiephone chargers from the floor

answer: The initial number of orange items on the floor is three (3), specifically in the form of textbooks. These orange textbooks are not affected by removing the scrunchiephone chargers; thus, after removing all the scrunchiephone chargers, there will still be three orange items remaining on the floor.
